sample_unit: independent two-time episode, target k=0, next payload unmodified
random_phase_distribution: uniform on [-delta,delta), fresh after target payload commitment; public baseline reveals the same phase before the attack chooses its action
postcommit_attack_reference: fixed zero phase only; no future-phase input to attack function
public_attack_reference: actual next phase known at action choice
reflection: Metropolis involution within reference prediction cell; reject if peak bound violated
detectors: event_only_phase_marginal: 1 - I_next_silence / nu_delta(P_target_post), where nu_delta is the phase-averaged healthy silence probability and P_target_post is the nominal covariance label determined by gamma0; consumes only gamma0,gamma1 and the covariance label
conditional_residual_comparator: I_send0*(p0_next_silence-I_next_silence), with p0 from the received target payload, actual next center and nominal covariance
detector_record: event-only uses only gamma0, next trusted event and its nominal covariance label. The comparator also reads the received target payload and phase-quantized next center.
calibration: split conformal upper quantile, strict alarm; separate healthy calibration and test; thresholds frozen for each model/protocol/delta/detector/block size, reused across attacks
damage: target true paired MSE and K^2 E action^2, healthy baseline within protocol
planning: analytic phase-integrated mean/variance and one-sided normal 1%/80% planning; not guaranteed power
trusted_audit_comparison: saved prior random-audit table at same legacy doses and b; separate seeds and scores, no paired significance claim
cost: count base sends, score availability, and one fresh phase draw per target; exact continuous phase is an ideal model and has no finite bit encoding; no hardware or cryptographic overhead is inferred
safe_update_gate: do not add estimator switching or downweighting unless this fixed detection experiment demonstrates useful power at legacy doses and comparable health/cost
